description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, triggering Ganax and Lathliss.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Ganax.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
